absolute_angle_assumption: outside to inside, first layer longitudinal X; no user confirmation of absolute orientation

pine.status: scenario, clear dry wood; species/grade/moisture not selected

fsf.status: E: SVEZA FSF minimum for 6.5-40 mm; extrapolation for 3-6 mm. Density/G/strength screening assumptions

glass.status: wet-layup T11/epoxy scenario, not measured laminate properties

XPS.status: E: H25 historical Technoplex analogue; G=6 MPa hypothetical sensitivity midpoint, NOT measured XPS property

EPS.status: E/density scenario; generic EPS G range 4-10 MPa in INNER-069; not a product passport

PIR.status: hypothetical E/G scenario; generic PUR data do not qualify PIR boards

PVC.status: Divinycell H80: nominal density, minimum compressive E used as in-plane isotropic analogue; minimum G and shear strength at 23C

SAN.status: Corecell M80: typical E/G/strength, NOT guaranteed minimum; compressive E used as in-plane analogue

balsa.status: Diab ProBalsa 2022 nominal density/G=24076 psi converted to 166 MPa/shear=435 psi converted to 3 MPa; in-plane E scenario, not out-of-plane compression E

PVC45.status: PVC45: same passport basis as PVC; rho nominal, E compressive analogue, G/shear minimum for PVC and typical for SAN

PVC60.status: PVC60: same passport basis as PVC; rho nominal, E compressive analogue, G/shear minimum for PVC and typical for SAN

PVC100.status: PVC100: same passport basis as PVC; rho nominal, E compressive analogue, G/shear minimum for PVC and typical for SAN

SAN60.status: SAN60: same passport basis as SAN; rho nominal, E compressive analogue, G/shear minimum for PVC and typical for SAN

SAN100.status: SAN100: same passport basis as SAN; rho nominal, E compressive analogue, G/shear minimum for PVC and typical for SAN

scope: independent flat one-way strips in X/Y with full ABD coupling, free membrane resultants; transverse shear added; no shell curvature, frame stiffness, impact, fatigue, fracture, bond failure or whole-vessel strength solved
screening_strength_limits: assigned reduced scenario stresses, not regulatory allowables. Core shear threshold min/3 only for PVC; typical/3 for SAN conditional. Other foams/balsa unqualified.
